description: Na₃Y(CO₃)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ama2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.58 Å. Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.46 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.31 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.30 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Y, and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing ONa₃YC trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to two Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Y, and one C atom.
